```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of 'Sleep Duration' based on 'BMI Category'
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', palette='coolwarm')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
